package.name: nuxeo-agentic-records
package.title: Nuxeo Satori records: disposition review and physical records

description.p: The records module's server add-on, on the platform's retention module. A disposition run holds the records whose retention has ended and that are under no legal hold; two people other than its starter approve it, and only then are the records deleted, or a physical record's destruction or transfer recorded, with a certificate kept as a record. Physical records have a barcode, a location and a chain of custody the server records. Everything is checked on the server, and nothing is disposed of until a run has its two approvals.
